title: Workspace login with SSO providers — Quillstack
notes: v2 moves the auth card to a Stitches design system (c-xxxxxx hashed classes) with React useId ids (':r3:'). The email/password form now comes before the SSO block; the SSO buttons move into a <qs-sso-providers> declarative shadow root and are reordered (Microsoft, Google, GitHub). 'Remember me' and 'Forgot password?' are swapped into one row under the password. Decoys: a 'Log in' / 'Sign up' tab bar (the 'Log in' tab is a button with the same text as the submit), a hidden sign-up tab panel with its own email/password inputs and a second <qs-sso-providers> (another 'Continue with GitHub'), a 'Trouble logging in?' help box with a 'Forgot your password?' link placed before the form, a honeypot text input and a hidden mobile menu. Copy changes: 'Sign in' -> 'Log in', 'E-mail' -> 'Email address', 'Remember me for 30 days' -> 'Keep me logged in'.
